Route6SaffronGuardWelcomeText:
Welcome to SAFFRON
CITY, home of the MAGNET TRAIN!

…That's what I'd
normally say, but

the MAGNET TRAIN
isn't running now.

It's not getting
any electricity

because there's
something wrong

with the POWER
PLANT.
Route6SaffronGuardMagnetTrainText:
The MAGNET TRAIN
is the most famous

thing about SAF-
FRON.
